content: For instance, recent market updates concerning North American logistics operations highlight a severe tightening of vessel capacity across major regional gateways [21] . This constrained capacity environment has driven climbing spot freight rates, compelling some customers to pivot toward Less than Container Load (LCL) strategies as a mechanism to sustain critical inventory flows and mitigate supply chain disruptions [21] . Identifying the specific dominant players and market leaders within the automotive cargo segment from the 2020 to 2023 timeframe presents notable challenges, as contemporary industry analyses predominantly focus on future projections and broader macroeconomic trends rather than retrospective competitive hierarchies [5] . The inherent limitation in historical data suggests that the industry has experienced significant paradigm shifts, rendering past leadership structures less relevant to current market dynamics. Consequently, modern competitive and market intelligence must prioritize contemporaneous analyses and forward-looking strategies to effectively evaluate the top companies operating within the automotive cargo sector today . The absence of specific historical leadership data also implies that competitive advantages are increasingly transient, compelling firms to focus their resources on future expansions and generalized market adaptations to secure their market share. Conversely, the competitive dynamics in North America are largely shaped by regional and localized challenges. Recent industry developments underscore a focus on localized problem-solving strategies within road transport, prioritizing the optimization of domestic supply chains over broader international shipping dynamics [33] . Nevertheless, top companies operating on a global scale must also navigate complex international shipping logistics, which have recently been characterized by significant challenges and fluctuations in transpacific spot rates [33] . To remain competitive amidst these logistical hurdles, leading automotive cargo transporters are increasingly participating in global summits to introduce and integrate new business models in logistics and automotive transport, revealing innovative approaches that are expected to foster a more resilient and competitive global market [32] .
